license_required.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice nursing in this state without a license

issuing_authority.quote: Board means the New Hampshire board of nursing established in RSA 326-B:3

name.quote: Board means the New Hampshire board of nursing established in RSA 326-B:3

type.quote: Board means the New Hampshire board of nursing established in RSA 326-B:3

umbrella_agency.value: Office of Professional Licensure and Certification
umbrella_agency.quote: the office of professional licensure and certification

moral_character_required.quote: Have committed no acts or omissions which are grounds for disciplinary action

degree_required.value: Graduate degree from accredited APRN education program for APRN; board-approved nursing education program for RN/LPN
degree_required.quote: Have graduated with a graduate degree earned in an accredited advanced practice registered nurse education program

accrediting_body.value: National Council of State Boards of Nursing; accrediting bodies recognized by United States Department of Education
accrediting_body.quote: standards established by a national credentialing or certification body recognized by the National Council of State Boards of Nursing

exams.name: NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN
exams.quote: The board shall administer the examination to applicants for licensure as RN's or LPN's

interval_years.quote: All license renewals shall be issued every 2 years

required.quote: Applicants for license renewal and license reinstatement shall complete continuing education

hours_per_period.quote: An LPN or an RN shall complete 30 hours of continuing education every 2 years

period_years.quote: An LPN or an RN shall complete 30 hours of continuing education every 2 years

topical_requirements.quote: An APRN, in addition to the continuing education requirements to renew or reinstate a license as an RN, shall complete 30 hours of continuing education every 2 years, 20 hours of which shall be specific to the specialty for which renewal or reinstatement is sought, and 5 hours of which shall be training in pharmacology appropriate to the specialty

available.quote: The nurse licensure compact is adopted and entered into with all other jurisdictions that legally join the compact

requirements.value: Multistate license available through Nurse Licensure Compact; single-state license also available
requirements.quote: A multistate license to practice registered or licensed practical/vocational nursing issued by a home state to a resident in that state will be recognized by each party state

exists.quote: Board means the New Hampshire board of nursing established in RSA 326-B:3

national_certification.value: National Council of State Boards of Nursing recognized certifying bodies
national_certification.quote: Be currently certified by a board-recognized national certifying body in the specialty for which the applicant was educated

national_association.value: National Council of State Boards of Nursing
national_association.quote: standards established by the National Council of State Boards of Nursing

regulatory_model.quote: Practice as a licensee without a license or when the license to do so has been revoked or suspended or when the license to do so has lapsed.

credential_type.quote: Practice as a licensee without a license or when the license to do so has been revoked or suspended or when the license to do so has lapsed.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice nursing in this state without a license

title_protection.quote: Use, in connection with the individual's name, any designation tending to imply licensure as an RN, an LPN, or an LNA unless so licensed

scope_protection.quote: Practice as a licensee without a license or when the license to do so has been revoked or suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license to practice nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public or demonstrating willful or careless disregard for health or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unethical conduct including but not limited to conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public or demonstrating a willful or careless disregard for the health or safety of a client

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or inability to perform nursing practice with reasonable skill and safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or inability to perform nursing or nursing assistant practice as defined in this chapter, with reasonable skill and safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Departure from or failure to conform to nursing standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct including but not limited to a departure from or failure to conform to nursing standards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating or accepting delegation of nursing function when it could result in unsafe or ineffective care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating or accepting the delegation of a nursing function or a prescribed health function when the delegation or acceptance could reasonably be expected to result in unsafe or ineffective client care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to supervise performance of acts by individuals working at the nurse's delegation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to supervise the performance of acts by any individual working at the nurse's delegation or assignment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Nursing practice that may create unnecessary danger to client's life, health, or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any nursing practice that may create unnecessary danger to a client's life, health, or safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice safely due to illness or mental or physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice safely, including demonstration of actual or potential inability to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety to clients by reason of illness or as a result of any mental or physical condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying reports, client documentation, or other essential health documents
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsifying reports, client documentation, agency records, or other essential health documents

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diversion or attempts to divert drugs or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Diversion or attempts to divert drugs or controlled substances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of controlled substance or drug in manner dangerous or injurious to self or others
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any controlled substance or any drug or device or alcoholic beverages to an extent or in a manner dangerous or injurious to himself or herself, any other person, or the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding, assisting, advising, or allowing an unlicensed person to engage in nursing practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding, assisting, advising, or allowing an unlicensed person to engage in the practice of nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing beyond the scope of practice and failing to report violations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing beyond the scope of practice as stated in this chapter, and failing to report violations of this chapter

definition_quote.value: Nursing means assisting clients or groups of clients to attain or maintain optimal health by implementing a strategy of care to accomplish defined goals and by evaluating responses to nursing care and medical treatment
definition_quote.quote: Nursing means assisting clients or groups of clients to attain or maintain optimal health by implementing a strategy of care to accomplish defined goals and by evaluating responses to nursing care and medical treatment

methods_authorized.quote: Providing comprehensive nursing assessment of the health status of clients, families, groups, and communities. Collaborating with a health care team to develop an integrated client-centered plan of health care. Developing a plan of nursing strategies to be integrated within the client-centered health care plan

drug_authority.value: APRN: plenary authority to possess, compound, prescribe, administer, and dispense controlled and non-controlled drugs within scope of practice; RN: no independent prescriptive authority; LPN: no independent prescriptive authority
drug_authority.quote: An APRN shall have plenary authority to possess, compound, prescribe, administer, and dispense and distribute to clients controlled and non-controlled drugs within the scope of the APRN's practice

license_tiers.quote: Advanced practice registered nurse or APRN means a registered nurse currently licensed by the board under RSA 326-B:18. Registered nurse or RN means an individual who holds a current license to practice registered nursing. Licensed practical nurse or LPN means an individual who holds a current license to practice practical nursing. Licensed nursing assistant or LNA means an individual who holds a current license to provide client care

value: APRN roles as recognized by National Council of State Boards of Nursing
aprn_role_categories.quote: The board shall not approve a new advanced practice specialty category that has not been developed by a national credentialing or certifying body recognized by the National Council of State Board of Nursing without approval of the legislature

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: An LPN shall, with or without compensation or personal profit, practice under the supervision of an RN, APRN, licensed physician, or dentist

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An APRN shall have plenary authority to possess, compound, prescribe, administer, and dispense and distribute to clients controlled and non-controlled drugs within the scope of the APRN's practice

value: Schedule II through IV for APRN
controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: An APRN licensed under this chapter may prescribe non-opioid and opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: APRN may prescribe opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV; subsequent evaluation required at intervals appropriate for patient, medical condition, and drug, but not less than annually
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: An APRN licensed under this chapter may prescribe non-opioid and opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine. When prescribing a non-opioid or opioid controlled drug classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine, a subsequent evaluation shall be conducted by a practitioner licensed to prescribe the drug at intervals appropriate for the patient, medical condition, and drug, but not less than annually

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: The office shall maintain a registry of nursing assistants who qualify pursuant to 42 C.F.R. section 483.156

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: Certified assisted living medication aide or CALMA means an individual who is certified by the office of professional licensure and certification to administer specific classes of and routes of medication

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: A nurse holding a currently valid license as an RN or an LPN may delegate specific nursing activities and tasks under the circumstances, and in accordance with the constraints, set forth in rules of the board

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: Every individual, agency, facility, institution, or organization that employs licensed nursing personnel within the state shall report to the board within 30 days any action by a licensee that willfully violates any provision of paragraph II

whistleblower_protection_for_delegation_.quote: No person may coerce an RN or an LPN into compromising client safety by requiring the nurse to delegate a nursing activity or task when the nurse determines that it is inappropriate to do so. A licensee shall not be subject to disciplinary action for refusing to delegate or refusing to provide training related to such delegation when the licensee has determined that such delegation may compromise client safety

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The nurse licensure compact is adopted and entered into with all other jurisdictions that legally join the compact

multistate_license_option_available.quote: A multistate license to practice registered or licensed practical/vocational nursing issued by a home state to a resident in that state will be recognized by each party state as authorizing a nurse to practice as a registered nurse (RN) or as a licensed practical/vocational nurse (LPN/VN), under a multistate licensure privilege, in each party state

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The office of professional licensure and certification shall contract with other organizations to operate the alternative recovery monitoring program for licensees who are impaired by substance use disorder or mental or physical illness

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: APRN may prescribe non-opioid and opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by telemedicine after establishing APRN-patient relationship; subsequent in-person evaluation required at intervals appropriate for patient, medical condition, and drug, but not less than annually
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: An APRN licensed under this chapter may prescribe non-opioid and opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine. When prescribing a non-opioid or opioid controlled drug classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine, a subsequent evaluation shall be conducted by a practitioner licensed to prescribe the drug at intervals appropriate for the patient, medical condition, and drug, but not less than annually

military_education_credit_required.quote: The implementation of strategies and criteria necessary to increase the acceptance of military training and experience towards licensure for military veterans seeking to be licensed as a nurse
